newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end easier, F&N slumps.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end easier, F&N slumps.

text.p: Singapore shares ended easier on Tuesday with index stock Fraser & Neave falling over two percent on poor earnings outlook.

F&N shares ended down 40 cents at Singapore $14.10 with 854,000 shares changing hands. The company recently said it expected its property earnings to fall by half in the current year, leading many firms to downgrade the stock. Analysts said there should be some support at current levels for F&N.
Dealers said the wider market was quiet though strong buying was seen in blue chip Singapore Land which rose 35 cents to S$8.20 in moderately active volume of about one million shares.
The Straits Times Industrials index ended down 6.74 points at 2,176.52. Volume was a light 80.97 million with 122 gainers against 188 losers.
Topping the actives was computer school Informatics which ended down one cent at S$0.62 on 6.55 million shares.

Among the gainers was Jurong Cement which rose five cents to end at S$6.25. Dealers said there has been steady accumulation of the counter by certain parties on old rumours of a takeover looming over the company.
